new_findings.title: Final stale-run checklist omits runtime fingerprint comparison
new_findings.defect: The stale-run definition at line 67 requires comparing embedding_model and numeric_runtime_fingerprint, but the final acceptance checklist only requires marking stale when embedding_model differs. An implementation can satisfy the checklist while omitting the new runtime stale check.
new_findings.failure_scenario: The active embedding_model remains unchanged across an OpenCV/ONNX/NumPy runtime change; the list path follows the checklist, reports the old atlas run as fresh, and carries its similarity_threshold/suggestion_floor bands across the changed embedding runtime.
new_findings.fix: Update the final checklist to require list-time comparison of the persisted numeric_runtime_fingerprint as well as embedding_model, and add a same-model/different-fingerprint stale-run assertion.

summary: Six prior findings are PARTIAL because their corrected documentation has no current regression guard; the golden identity parity correction HOLDS with a direct assertion. FIR-9 retains one medium stale-run checklist gap, and the lane test passed (26 tests).
